goal: 用户/账号图标，用于登录状态显示和用户信息入口

subject.concept: 人物头像轮廓，圆形头部加肩部弧线
subject.symbolism: 用户身份、个人账户、学员信息，VR培训系统的用户标识

style.rendering: 线性图标（line icon），纯描边无填充

prompt: A minimalist line-art icon of a user avatar, showing a circle for the head positioned in the upper portion and a curved arc below representing the shoulders and upper body silhouette, single color #00B4D8 (cyan blue) on transparent background, 128x128 pixels, clean modern style, 2px uniform stroke with round linecap and linejoin, no fill, no gradient, no shadow, centered with 16px safe area padding, vector-style clean edges, standard user profile icon shape, suitable for VR medical training application

must_keep: 头部圆形 + 肩部弧线
